findings.reason: without §15 in s16's depends-on (or an explicit qualification that the full-width load waits for §15), the section installs an instruction whose core promise — load everything, the queue launches the tails — fails for metered-routed work in exactly the way §15's comment records.
findings.text: s16 declares only `s3` as its upstream, but its mechanism tells the coordinator to dispatch the whole width "naming no lane so the picker routes each", and §7 (landed) prefers an elevated-risk node onto a lifted metered lane; the plan's own §15 comment at line 289 measures the result — a codex-routed request that becomes ready after dispatch never launches, because the only admit pass on the fleet runs `crew admit --lane clive`. s16 can therefore be dispatched (s3 alone) and installed before §15, and every metered-routed tail it loads parks `awaiting-upstream` and then sits forever — silently, since §16 itself says the node "needs nothing further from the coordinator".

findings.reason: the followup is the running build order, so omitting an implementable section leaves §13's s16 dependency unsatisfiable without a coordinator re-deriving the set.
findings.text: the open followup f-aqhwp-002's build order runs "§4, §3, §7, §10, §9, §11, §15, §12, §13 and §14" in declared-wait order but omits s16 entirely and still lists s7, which the plan declares `done` at line 23; a coordinator working that followup will skip the only section that installs the instruction and will dispatch a finished one.
